name: FreeFix
definition: A fine-tuning-free approach to improve the rendering quality of extrapolated views in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) by leveraging pretrained image diffusion models (IDMs) without requiring costly fine-tuning or video diffusion models.
summary: FreeFix improves 3D Gaussian Splatting rendering quality via fine-tuning-free diffusion models, distinguished by its 2D-3D interleaved refinement using Fisher information confidence masks.
